# ASP reference encoding

`Defeasible-Deontic-Logic/` contains the `Basic/` encodings, `language.asp` and
upstream README from https://github.com/gvdgdo/Defeasible-Deontic-Logic at
revision `679c638c2fddf97e1ee624cc528e84be6fd02d95`.

These upstream files are unchanged. The comparison scripts under
`X-Men_2.0/scripts/dl-oracle/` create temporary patched copies and report
upstream and patched results separately. Their descriptions explain the
corrections and the oracle's scope.

Only reference files needed by these checks are included. Upstream Git
metadata, examples, tutorials and unrelated deontic encodings are omitted.
The application uses the Java reasoner in `X-Men_2.0/`.
